text: Chapter 2 reviews the BGP, routing-security, measurement, and machine-learning literature that grounds the study. Chapter 3 describes the final methodology, including corpus construction, RouteViews processing, feature engineering, leakage controls, and modeling. Chapter 4 presents the results from feature development through Final Holdout evaluation. Chapter 5 summarizes the findings, contributions, limitations, and future work.

Chapter 4 reports the final experimental sequence from feature development through the one-time Final Holdout evaluation. Results are presented at the incident level unless otherwise stated. Developmental results are included only when they explain a final methodological decision.
